main_text.p: mnes gentes longo interual-lo superauit. Artes porrò hu iusce generis tres uideo fuis-se:quarum prima in iure constituendo, altera in bene dicendi facultate, tertia in rei militaris administratione posita est. neque enim aut societas inter ciues sine iure coiri, aut pacis ornamenta sine eloquentia retineri, aut belli pericula finitimorumque iniuriae sine rei militaris disciplina repelli possunt. Praeter illas tres, totidem alias, in quibus aliae gentes suum studium magnopere posuerunt, reperio fuisse: Philosophiam: fabrilem, quam μηχανικὴν[?] Græ

page.notes: The running head at the top is largely covered by a dark mark, so its title is not legible. The Greek word μηχανικὴν is read with some doubt. The catchword "ciuo-" is printed at the lower right as "ciuo-" and is kept with its hyphen.
